about: Recording batch E3c of ADR 0012, FX errors: the catalogue cases of FX-12 to FX-15 and FX-30 to FX-38 (FX-36's executor part only) and of FX-V6, with FX-10/a, which also needs a failure module. Each case is recorded on the CE oracle by a run of the fixtures below, or deferred with a milestone and a reason. TestRecordingBatches enforces it.
